reason: B gives me more reason to consider staying: it promises to explain the shift rotation before I have to decide, offers to work around my circumstances, and lays out a clear process with a deadline, a private HR contact and an all-staff meeting. A is more direct with me and more honest about the costs, but it leaves me unsure what happens next, and B's unfilled placeholders and talking about us as 'them' only partly weaken it.
